narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On April 12, 2024, at approximately 1215 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] was asked by the Ottawa County Sheriff's Office to help identify a passenger in a vehicle stopped near Zeeland, Michigan. The passenger, the subject, stated that he is a citizen of Mexico.
He handed the agent a Mexican voter identification card (INE) bearing his name and photograph, along with a copy of his birth certificate from Puebla. He stated that he has no visa or other papers allowing him to be in the United States.
ENTRY:
He stated that he crossed the border illegally on foot near Douglas, Arizona, on 01/20/2021.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
